changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Route broad yearly flowerbiz sales questions to the dbt sales summary template instead of generic LLM workflow.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO copilot_ai.nl2sql_query_template (template_code, domain, role_hint, intent_patterns, question_samples, sql_template, parameters, target_view, description, priority, is_active) VALUES ('TPL-52', 'flowerbiz', NULL, '[".*(20\\d{2}|\\d{4}年|今年|去年).*(销售|售花|卖花).*(情况|统计|汇总|金额|收入).*",".*(销售|售花|卖花).*(20\\d{2}|\\d{4}年|今年|去年).*(情况|统计|汇总|金额|收入).*"]', '["查询2026年销售情况","统计2026年销售金额","今年销售情况汇总"]', $tpl$SELECT s."业务月份", s."项目", ROUND(SUM(s."销售金额全口径")::numeric, 2) AS "销售金额", SUM(s."销售单数") AS "销售单数", SUM(s."赠送单数") AS "赠送单数", ROUND(SUM(s."赠送成本全口径")::numeric, 2) AS "赠送成本" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_sale_summary s WHERE s."业务月份" >= to_char(DATE ':year-01-01', 'YYYY-MM') AND s."业务月份" < to_char(DATE ':year-01-01' + INTERVAL '1 year', 'YYYY-MM') GROUP BY s."业务月份", s."项目" ORDER BY s."业务月份", "销售金额" DESC LIMIT 200$tpl$, '{"year":{"type":"integer","required":true}}', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_sale_summary', '年度销售情况汇总（dbt mart）', 35, true) ON CONFLICT (template_code) DO UPDATE SET domain = EXCLUDED.domain, role_hint = EXCLUDED.role_hint, intent_patterns = EXCLUDED.intent_patterns, question_samples = EXCLUDED.question_samples, sql_template = EXCLUDED.sql_template, parameters = EXCLUDED.parameters, target_view = EXCLUDED.target_view, description = EXCLUDED.description, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, updated_at = now();
